name: Ranger Brigand melee auto-attacks after Auto Shot instead of Auto Shot resetting swing timers (#13233)
contract: #13233: Ranger Brigand (Dueling specialization 30) gains Ravager 92116 (SPELL_AURA_ASCENSION_IGNORE_MIN_RANGE, misc 10 = IGNORE_MIN_RANGE_RANGED_ABILITIES), whose tooltip removes the minimum range of ranged abilities (contrast Deadeye 300700 'ranged abilities and Auto Shot') and whose Spell.dbc mask covers only family-27 Ranger shots, not Auto Shot 75 (family 9, SPELL_ATTR2_AUTO_REPEAT). Unit::IgnoresSpellMinRange previously matched Auto Shot 75 under IGNORE_MIN_RANGE_RANGED_ABILITIES; because Unit::_UpdateAutoRepeatSpell runs before melee swings in Player::Update and calls resetAttackTimer(BASE_ATTACK) and resetAttackTimer(OFF_ATTACK) on every shot, a Brigand with a bow faster than their melee weapon (Light Hunting Bow 2780 at 1700 ms vs Brushwood Blade 18957 at 3000 ms) fired Auto Shot at point-blank range and starved melee auto-attacks to zero. Expected: after pulling with Auto Shot 75 at 15 yds and the defensive enemy closing to melee range, Auto Shot stops firing inside melee range, CMSG_ATTACKSWING lands main-hand melee swings, and Ravager still lets Quick Shot 500074 cast at melee range.

steps.label: Equip Light Hunting Bow (1700 ms bow)
SETUP: main hand holds the slower melee weapon
SETUP: Auto Shot hits the enemy at range
SETUP: the enemy closes to melee range
Let any in-flight arrow from outside melee range land
The enemy is the Brigand's melee victim
DISCRIMINATING: main-hand melee auto-attacks land instead of being reset by Auto Shot
DISCRIMINATING: Auto Shot does not fire inside melee range under Ravager
Control: Quick Shot still ignores minimum range under Ravager
CONTROL: Ravager still removes minimum range on Ranger ranged abilities
